buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading and equilibration

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as stored in eLabFTW)

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting during loading (instrument units)

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition on the plate

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used per well

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand being loaded onto the resin

total_volume_uL.description: Total liquid volume per well used for loading

pump_duration_s.description: Duration of pump operation during loading

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used across columns

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles performed before loading

equilibration_volume_uL.description: Volume used for each equilibration cycle

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations used across rows

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength used on the Tecan plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve relating absorbance to concentration

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit for salt concentrations, e.g. mM or M

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the salt stock solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations, e.g. uM or mM

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand stock solution

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve relating absorbance to concentration

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations on the plate

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations on the plate

analysis_status.description: Status of the loading isotherm analysis as reported by the analysis script

timestamp.description: Time when results were committed to the database (UTC)

summary.description: Key metrics extracted from the analysis script output

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations as used for analysis

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations as used for analysis

replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition used in analysis

resin_mass_mg.description: Resin mass used per well, as interpreted by the analysis script

total_volume_uL.description: Total liquid volume per well, as interpreted by the analysis script

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Ligand concentration unit used in fits

salt_concentration_unit.description: Salt concentration unit used in fits

n_salt_conditions_with_fit.description: Number of salt conditions for which Langmuir fits were successfully obtained

fit_results.description: Per-salt Langmuir fit parameters extracted from the analysis JSON

R2.description: Coefficient of determination for the fit

n_points.description: Number of data points used for the fit

data_files.description: Structured listing of analysis data output files

tecan_raw_excel.description: Path to raw Tecan Excel file used in analysis

analysis_results_json.description: Path to full analysis results JSON file

plots.description: Plot files produced by the analysis script

raw_analysis_output.description: Raw JSON structure saved by the analysis script (for debugging and provenance)

all_result_files.description: Flat list of all files present in the results folder at commit time
